@@U00413@@
Do without! Do without! There’s the world’s advice! There’s the song that sings eternally, that rings in our ears, year in, year out, hour after hour, minute by minute, singing hoarsely till the day we die! I wake each morning in terror, horrified, wishing I could shed hot, bitter tears for the day that will give me nothing, not one wish fulfilled, not one satisfaction, not one! the day that will drag down to defeat every faint promise of pleasure with its constant, capricious carping, that with a thousand petty impediments, with life’s ugliness, its mockery, will lay to waste my soul’s creative urge. And then when night draws close, and I lie on my bed, I expect no rest, but anxiety to haunt me, desperation, and wild, ungoverned dreams to terrify me. The divinity that rules my heart, that governs my powers, can shake my soul to its depths, but is helpless where the world is concerned. And so, Life is an enemy, Being a burden, and only Death to be wished for.

@@U00415@@
And yet, not even Death is a wholly welcome guest.
translation:
@@U00413@@
不用！不用！世界各地都有建议！有一首永恒的歌，在我们耳边响起，年复一年，一小时又一小时，一分钟又一分钟，沙哑地唱到我们死去的那一天！每天早上我都在恐惧中醒来，感到恐惧，希望自己能在这一天流下滚烫、苦涩的泪水，但那一天却什么也没有给我带来任何好处，一个愿望都没有实现，没有一个满足，一个都没有！在那一天，它将用它不断的、反复无常的吹毛求疵来挫败每一个微弱的快乐承诺，用成千上万的小障碍，用生活的丑陋和嘲笑，将浪费我灵魂的创造性冲动。然后，当夜幕降临时，我躺在床上，我不希望休息，但焦虑却困扰着我，绝望和狂野的、不受控制的梦境让我感到恐惧。掌管我心、掌管我力量的神性，可以深深震撼我的灵魂，但对于世界却无能为力。所以，生是敌人，是负担，唯有死是可求的。

@@U00415@@
然而，即使是死亡也不是一个完全受欢迎的客人。
